headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment using AI to provide users with detailed insights on potential vulnerabilities and risks associated with npm/PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansion. Leverage machine learning models to predict and mitigate installation risks proactively.
actions: Implement an AI-driven risk scoring system that analyzes package dependencies and historical data to flag potentially risky installations before they occur.
